cards.title: One evidence-record kernel: registry-driven replay-save and school census

cards.rollback: Series of 3 commits (kernel+tests, replay-save + shims, school-census + shims); each reverts alone. Shims keep every documented command path working, so a revert leaves no orphaned docs. No simulator code or evidence JSON is modified.

cards.body:
## Summary
Four copies of the season replay-save script (u1, u2, u3, w7) and two copies of the school census (h1-report, cf-report) are the evidence spine for every wave since U1, yet each new wave means editing a hand-maintained regex, the records stamp a command that does not reproduce them, and `passed` is a literal. Fold them into one evidence-record kernel with a derived wave registry.

## Description
`evidence-record.ts` owns `resolveWave(id)` (derived from `docs/waves/<id>-evidence/` existing, replacing u3-replay.ts:48's regex), `stampCommand(entry, args)` (the record's `command` is the argv that actually ran, including `--wave`), and `writeRecord(path, record)` (stable key order, trailing newline, as today). `replay-save.ts` is the one parameterized replay: `replaySaveRecord({wave, make})` runs `make` twice, round-trips, and derives `passed` from the hash equalities instead of asserting and then writing `true`. `school-census.ts` is the one census loop with an `extras` column set; h1-report.ts and cf-report.ts become 3-line shims selecting their wave and extras. u1/u2/u3/w7-replay.ts become shims so every command quoted in docs/waves/*.md still works.

## Flow
- Builder writes evidence-record.test.ts cases 1-7 first (red: modules missing).
- Extract the kernel; port replay-save with an injectable `make` so tests use a day-1 fixtureService, not two 14-day seasons.
- Port the census with an injectable seed list; shims for the six legacy entry points.
- `npm run gate` green; replay goldens and VR vectors untouched (no packages/core change).

## Expected impact
New waves (W8 today) get a replay-save record with zero code edits; every record's `command` reproduces it; a failed double replay is recorded as `passed:false` instead of a crash with no record; about 250 duplicated lines become one tested module.

## Evaluation
Claim: the evidence recorders become one tested, registry-driven kernel.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no kernel; W8 rejected; CF2 command wrong; passed literal)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - vitest evidence-record.test.ts inside `npm run gate`
Result: better
Gate: architecture

cards.title: Owner blind read that records its verdict: capture, unblind, report
shared_surfaces: docs/waves/W1-evidence/OWNER-READ.html and blind-source-map.json (regenerated by blind.ts; not listed in archive.ts:10-20 so not an archive-manifest file)

acceptance: case 1: renderBlindPage(three pairs) -> HTML with 3 <section>, 6 <article>, and per morning a radio group name='morning-N' with values A|B|tie plus a notes <textarea>; body text does not match blind-check.ts:21's source-label regex
case 2: exportResponses(formState) -> JSON {pageHash, responses:[{morning, choice, notes}]} containing no source label string (sonnet|claude|ollama|planner|live)

cards.rollback: Two commits (blind-pair module + tests + page form; blind-score + report line). Reverting the second leaves a page that captures but is not scored; reverting both restores the paper form. The regenerated OWNER-READ.html is the only evidence file touched and blind.ts reproduces it.

cards.body:
## Summary
The owner blind read of Director mornings has been 'pending' since W1 because the page is a paper form: there is nowhere to click, nothing to save, and no code that unblinds an answer. Make the page capture A/B/tie and notes, export a label-free response file bound to the page hash, and score it against the kept mapping so the W1 report states the owner's verdict.

## Description
`blind-pair.ts` holds the pure parts: deterministic side assignment (unchanged rule), `renderBlindPage` with an inline, dependency-free form (radios + textarea + a 'Save my answers' button that downloads `owner-read-responses.json`), `exportResponses`, `parseResponses` (closed vocabulary, unique mornings, pageHash binding), `unblind` and `ownerReadLine`. blind.ts uses it to render; `blind-score.ts` (`npm run blind:score -- <file>`) unblinds into `docs/waves/W1-evidence/owner-read-result.json` labelled 'owner, felt, n=3'; report.ts:424 renders `ownerReadLine(result)` instead of a constant. The page still shows no source label; the mapping never enters the page or the response file.

## Flow
- Owner opens OWNER-READ.html, picks A/B/tie per morning, adds notes, clicks Save (one step instead of print, write, transcribe, unblind by hand).
- Operator runs `npm run blind:score -- owner-read-responses.json`; `npm run report` shows the verdict.
- A stale or tampered response file is refused with the reason.

## Expected impact
The first owner-felt measurement in the evidence system gets a path from the page to the report; the live-Director vs planner decision (PLAN 116) gets its owner input. The module is reusable for any later blind A/B read.

## Evaluation
Claim: the blind read can be answered, saved, unblinded and reported.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no form, no export, no scorer, constant report line)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - vitest blind-pair.test.ts inside `npm run gate`; blind-check.ts (Playwright) stays a coordinator smoke
Result: better
Gate: direction
